title: 第九章 强悍的六须鲶鱼第十章 宝鱼
content_zh:
泽鼎泛起灵光，散逸在水中的鲜血在某种神奇力量的汇聚下凝而不散，缓缓刻在六须鲶鱼光滑的背部。
川字水符在幽暗水域中自放血光，拼命挣扎的六须鲶鱼瞬间呆滞。
强悍的精神力量轰入脑中，梁渠只觉得后脑被重锤击中，头晕目眩。
他鼻腔一热，便察觉到有血液涌出，此次统御六须鲶鱼，比之猪婆龙更为凶险！
两者虽体型相差无几，可半冬眠状态的猪婆龙抵抗意志远没有六须鲶鱼强烈！
终于在僵持过十数个呼吸后，脑海中的精神意志迅速衰退。
川字符隐入鲶鱼皮层之下，消失不见，又一股截然不同的精神链接出现在梁渠脑海之中。
成了！
深感疲惫的梁渠面露惊喜，同时闪过一丝后怕。
六须鲶鱼的抵抗居然如此强烈，上次猪婆龙能成，属实侥幸。
好在成了就是成了，精神链接一建立，生死皆在掌控中，不存在背叛可能。
运气也是实力的一部分。
泽鼎散发光华。
【已统御六须鲶鱼，可进化】
【可消耗八十点水泽精华，使六须鲶鱼进化为虎头鲶。
同样的可进化提示，可惜梁渠依旧没有那么多水泽精华，也只能等日后再说。
一番挣扎，他气力皆尽，赶紧召唤两兽，双手各抓一尾，让它们带自己浮出水面换气。
哗啦。
“呼！”
梁渠抹去脸上水渍，大口呼吸，疼痛眩晕的大脑迅速恢复清醒，犹如盛夏日喝了一口冰汽水。

天色尚早，借着日光，缓过劲来的梁渠观摩着两兽硕大骇人的体型，一股自豪与安全感油然而生。
有两兽相助，即便癞头张那样高头大马的人不曾受伤，落入水中也要被他肆意拿捏。
只不过......
梁渠望着六须鲶鱼尾部撕裂的伤口，不禁心疼起来，现在都是自家崽啊！
先前不能动与六须鲶鱼争斗，不能动皮糙肉厚啥事没有，六须鲶鱼却被咬出好大一个疤，这也是不能动的优点，猪婆龙灵活性和耐力比一般鱼差很多，可架不住攻高血厚！
“既然你那么胖，就叫你肥鲶鱼吧，阿肥！”
梁渠顺手给六须鲶鱼取个名，得到了欣喜的情绪传递后，便带着两兽回到莲藕水域，掰下一块莲藕喂给六须鲶鱼。
这块莲藕不含水泽精华，但同样有治愈效果，只是弱上不少。
肥鲶鱼吃下后，尾部伤口以肉眼可见的速度愈合起来，只不过速度慢不少。
阿肥在水中打了个滚，开始绕着梁渠转圈。
估摸着一块效果足够，梁渠回到船上喂给不能动几条鱼，让其接着看家，接着让肥鲶鱼伤愈后，以莲藕水域为中心帮自己捕鱼。
六须鲶鱼捕食能力强悍，一张大嘴一吸就能抓住许多小鱼，还不会留下明显伤口让人怀疑鱼的出处，这也是梁渠想统御六须鲶鱼的原因。
“捕到了鱼就吐在这里面，注意不要让人看到。”
梁渠将船尾的板子掀开，指着里面的空档。
癞头张的舢板虽简陋，可也算是五脏俱全，总长有三米多，结构和正常渔船一样，船头船尾有两个防水隔间，能用来放鱼。
肥鲶鱼在水面起伏，晃起脑袋。
精神链接对水兽而言并不是全无好处，至少从梁渠观察到的看，建立链接后的水兽明显更聪明，有一定的思考能力，不再是单纯的野兽。
content_en:
The Zeding glowed with spiritual light, and the blood scattered in the water condensed under the condensation of some magical power and was slowly carved on the smooth back of the six-bearded catfish.
The Sichuan water talisman bleeds in the dark waters, and the six-bearded catfish struggling desperately becomes sluggish for an instant.
The powerful mental power blasted into his head, and Liang Qu felt like he was hit by a heavy hammer on the back of his head, making him dizzy.
As soon as his nasal cavity became hot, he noticed blood gushing out. This time, he was controlling the six-bearded catfish, which was more dangerous than the pig-shaped dragon!
Although the size of the two is almost the same, the resistance of the semi-hibernating Pig Dragon is far less strong than that of the Six-bearded Catfish!
Finally, after holding on for more than ten breaths, the mental will in my mind quickly declined.
The Sichuan characters disappeared under the catfish's cortex, and another completely different spiritual link appeared in Liang Qu's mind.
Done!
Liang Qu, who was deeply tired, showed surprise and a hint of fear.
The resistance of the six-bearded catfish is actually so strong. It was a fluke that Zhupolong succeeded last time.
Fortunately, once it is done, it is done. Once the spiritual link is established, life and death are under control, and there is no possibility of betrayal.
Luck is also part of strength.
Zeding exudes brilliance.
[The six-bearded catfish has been controlled and can evolve]
[Eighty points of water essence can be consumed to evolve the six-bearded catfish into a tiger-headed catfish.
The same evolvable reminder, but unfortunately Liangqu still doesn’t have that much water essence, so we can only wait until later.
After a struggle, he lost all his strength and quickly summoned the two beasts, grabbing one tail with each hand and letting them bring him to the surface for air.
Wow.
"Phew!"
Liang Qu wiped off the water stains on his face and took a deep breath. His painful and dizzy brain quickly regained consciousness, as if he had taken a sip of ice soda on a hot summer day.
It was still early, and with the help of the sunlight, Liang Qu, who had regained his strength, observed the huge and terrifying figures of the two beasts, feeling a sense of pride and security.
With the help of two beasts, even if a tall man like Mangy Zhang is not injured, he will still be manipulated by him if he falls into the water.
It's just...
Liang Qu looked at the torn wound on the tail of the six-bearded catfish and couldn't help but feel distressed. Now they are all his own cubs!
Previously, I couldn't move to fight with the six-bearded catfish. It was no big deal if I couldn't move because it had thick skin and thick flesh. However, the six-bearded catfish was bitten and left a big scar. This is also an advantage of being unable to move. The flexibility and endurance of the pig dragon are much worse than those of ordinary fish, but it can't withstand high attacks and thick blood!
"Since you are so fat, let's call you Fat Catfish, Ah Fat!"
Liang Qu casually named the six-bearded catfish, and after receiving the joyful emotion, he took the two beasts back to the lotus root waters, broke off a piece of lotus root and fed it to the six-bearded catfish.
This piece of lotus root does not contain water essence, but it still has a healing effect, but it is much weaker.
After eating the fat catfish, the tail wound healed at a speed visible to the naked eye, but the speed was much slower.
Ah Fei rolled in the water and began to circle around Liangqu.
Guessing that one piece would be enough, Liang Qu returned to the boat and fed a few fish that could not move and let them continue to look after the house. Then, after the fat catfish recovered from its injuries, it could help him fish around the lotus root waters.
The six-bearded catfish has a powerful hunting ability. It can catch many small fish with a single suck of its big mouth without leaving any obvious wounds that make people doubt where the fish came from. This is why Liang Qu wants to control the six-bearded catfish.
"When you catch a fish, spit it in here. Be careful not to let anyone see it."
Liang Qu lifted up the stern board and pointed to the gap inside.
Although Le Touzhang's sampan is simple, it is well-equipped, with a total length of more than three meters. Its structure is the same as that of a normal fishing boat. There are two waterproof compartments at the bow and stern, which can be used to release fish.
The fat catfish rose and fell in the water, shaking its head.
The spiritual link is not without benefits for the water beasts. At least from what Liang Qu observed, the water beasts after establishing the link are obviously smarter and have certain thinking ability, and are no longer simple beasts.
